body: Commits d917252/7d0a871 on main. Root-caused 'toggleable abilities arent working': w_active was never synced over the wire, so networked clients' W-tile active highlight was always wrong regardless of real server state -- fixed via ArenaHeroSnapshot. Also implemented founder's mana-drain redesign: the 10 true-toggle heroes now activate free (mp>0 gate) and drain ARENA_MP_DRAIN_W_PER_SEC continuously while active instead of paying a flat upfront cost, auto-deactivating at 0 mana. New arena_hero_w_is_toggle() lets the client HUD apply the right mana-cost model per hero (instant-effect W heroes like Ghost/Frog are unaffected, still flat-cost). 2 tests rewritten, 2 added, full suite green.
title: Fix w_active wire sync + toggle W mana drain redesign (S170-180/181)
